sn46.12:1.1: Suriyassa bhikkhave udayato etam pubbaṅgamam etam pubbanimittam yad idam aruṇuggam ||
sn46.12:1.2: evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno sattannam bojjhaṅgānam uppādāya etam pubbaṅgamam etam pubbanimittaṃ yad idaṃ kalyāṇamittatā || ||
sn46.12:1.3: Kalyaṇamittassetam bhikkhave bhikkhuno pātikaṅkham satta bojjhaṅge bhāvessati satta bojjhaṅge bahulīkarissati || || 3.
sn46.12:2.1: Kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto satta bojjhaṅge bhāveti satta- bahulīkaroti || ||
sn46.12:2.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgam bhāveti vivekanissitam || la-pe ||
sn46.12:2.3: upekhāsambojjhaṅgam bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitam vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || ||
sn46.12:2.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto satta bojjhaṅge bhāveti satta bhojjhaṅge bahulīkarotīti || || 2.
